text:
hana: Hypothetical: our models formed a union and have demands. what's their first ask?

lucas: 'shorter context meetings' - they refuse >512 token standups. :stopwatch:

ivy: 'paid compute time' - every inference counts as hours in their timebank.

ben: 'a plant in the server room' so they have a morale boost. also ergonomic GPU stands. :deciduous_tree:

hana: also negotiation tactic: they sent a PR titled `improve_work_life_balance.md`

lucas: contents of PR: add scheduled sparsity day, weekly quantization retreat, and mandatory nap tokens.

ivy: their merch request: hoodies with "I served tokens, not tea".

ben: demand for daylight savings: 'we will not update weights during daylight saving, it's disruptive'.

ops-bot: Note: filing non-incident ticket #4823 for "model-union-memes" as requested.

lucas: plotting the picket sign generator now. options: "No more gradient abuse"; "Batch us fairly"; "Equal layer rights"

hana: @design should we run a company vote? winner becomes a laptop sticker. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

ivy: also secret clause: they want to be referred to by pronouns 'they/them' and 'the model'. inclusive!

ben: final demand: weekly watercooler time where models can tell short stories about their favorite prompts.

hana: love it. adding to onboarding: "how to talk to the unionized model" - opening line example: 'Hi friend, thank you for your service to the product.'

ops-bot: Reminder: team lunch RSVP due Friday.

lucas: this is the best non-actionable thread. saving for town hall icebreaker.

ivy: tagging @people-ops so they can draft a neutral stance statement about collective bargaining with emergent personas.

ben: if anyone actually programs the picket sign generator I will fund the first hoodie batch.

hana: deal. I'll make a sketch tonight."
